audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Vladimir Levels 2 and 3; the packet level chart says Skill for rows 0-4 and Vladimir for rows 5-6. The mirror (karma__vladimir) was already set to the packet chart.
audit.why: 51.58% over 1392 games is an even lane; Vladimir has no level-2/3 advantage over a 950-range poke enchanter.
audit.corrected: phases[1].side/win[1] and phases[2].side/win[2] flipped to Skill, proposed as a matched atomic group so full and content agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 text implied Karma spikes at 6 in one place and not in another; no real cooldown numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Mantra is available at level 1 and needs no skill point (Riot text), so 6 is purely Vladimir's spike: Hemoplague, 120s, amps damage and heals per champion hit.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names the 120s Hemoplague spike and states Mantra was already online; spikes[2] keyed to Riftmaker plus Grievous Wounds timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] attributed the root to Karma's empowered Q ('empowered Q roots'). The root is Focused Resolve (W). Text also called Focused Resolve 'a long cooldown'.
audit.why: Riot text: Mantra Q creates a delayed cataclysm, no CC; W creates a tether that roots only if it is not broken. W is a flat 12s at every rank, 675 range. Vladimir's E (Tides of Blood) is explicitly blockable by enemy units.
audit.corrected: Root reassigned to W; the tether-break (distance/LoS out of 675) stated as the answer instead of pooling; 12s flat, Mantra 40/38/36/34s, Pool 28-16s, Hemoplague 120s written in; E-blocked-by-minions added to the level 3 row.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Mantra W healing Karma through extended trades.
audit.why: _missing entry 'needs-antiheal' for this matchup; Riot text on W Mantra bonus: 'healing herself'.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds timing folded into spikes[2].text.

edits.before: Weather the poke — drain him down and pool the Focused Resolve answer. Vladimir wins the Focused Resolve cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather Inner Flame poke — Focused Resolve is only a 12s root, so trade inside its gap and pool the tether, not the chip.

edits.before: Drain him down and pool the Focused Resolve answer. Track Focused Resolve before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Drain her down and pool Focused Resolve — the tether breaks on distance. Count her 12s root and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: Karma wins by landing Focused Resolve, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Karma wins by rooting you with Focused Resolve, poking Inner Flame, and kiting you off the wave.

edits.before: Pool answers his single biggest button — save it for exactly that. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: Pool answers her root, not her poke — save it for exactly that. Focused Resolve is 12s flat, so trade in the window after it drops.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units — step clear so your E reaches Karma, not minions.

edits.before: Hemoplague + empowered Q turns mid-game fights into resets. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Hemoplague amps your follow-up damage and heals off her, a real 120s spike. Mantra was up from level 1, so 6 hands Karma nothing new.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve: 12s flat — the tether roots only if unbroken, so walk out of its 675 range. - Mantra: 40s, shortened by her damage. - Pool: 16-28s, saved for the root. - Hemoplague: 120s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her tether roots only if unbroken — step outside 675 range or behind terrain and it fizzles.

edits.before: Karma's empowered Q (Mantra + Inner Flame) roots and pokes hard; sidestep the slow-then-root windup and don't get caught behind the wave where her RQ line chunks you.
edits.after: Karma's Mantra Q (Inner Flame) does not root — that is Focused Resolve (W). Dodge the delayed cataclysm, and break her 675-range tether by walking, not by pooling.

edits.before: With Rylai's/Riftmaker online your Transfusion sustain outheals her poke and your Q-E burst threatens her thin HP bar, tilting first item to you.
edits.after: With Riftmaker online your Transfusion outheals her poke, and Grievous Wounds cuts the Mantra W heal that saves her — buy it before you commit.

edits.before: Level 2 stays skill-based since Karma's empowered root is her only real tool and it's on a long cooldown.
edits.after: Level 2 stays skill-based: Focused Resolve is a 12s root, not a long cooldown, so pick the gap, don't pool.

edits.before: Land empowered RQ roots to poke and zone you off the wave
edits.after: Land Focused Resolve, then Mantra Q, to zone you off the wave

notes: Level-chart rows 1 and 2 proposed as matched full/content pairs to align with the packet chart and the already-audited mirror. Root was misattributed to Karma's Mantra Q throughout the page; it belongs to Focused Resolve (W), 12s flat at every rank. Whether the tether break requires losing line of sight or only exceeding range is not in Riot's text — I wrote 'outside 675 range or behind terrain' which the text supports as distance; the LoS half is unverified.
